assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia contributing to these symptoms
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered
The monitoring is intended to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The service addresses the specific clinical need to evaluate the source of the patient's dizziness and giddiness
